# luko13 — Luis Santiago Chillón Serratosa

> Portfolio of a full-stack developer based in Fuengirola, Spain. Founder of
> Jornal and co-founder of mmento. Builds complete web products, from the
> interface to the infrastructure. Single-page site with a Japanese hanami
> concept: the scroll traverses one day under the cherry tree.

## Featured work

- [mmento](https://mmentoapp.com): mobile app where magicians keep their repertoire; offline-first, pgvector semantic search, live on the App Store and Google Play.
- [Jornal](https://jornal.work): Spanish labour-law compliant time tracking SaaS; multi-tenant Postgres RLS, in production with real customers.
- mmento Analytics: internal product dashboard; 34 Postgres functions, cohort retention computed live.
